request_user:
Fact: integration_means
What to find: Technical means for integrating the model (usage instructions, APIs, serving frameworks, prompt/chat format).
Card sections that often contain it: How to Use, Quickstart, Usage, Deployment

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Usable via transformers (v4.53.0+) with AutoModelForCausalLM/AutoTokenizer and chat template; also vLLM and SGLang for OpenAI-compatible API serving; local inference with llama.cpp, ONNX, MLX, MLC and ExecuTorch. Chat format supports /think and /no_think system prompt flags or enable_thinking kwarg; tool calling via xml_tools or python_tools.
quotes: The modeling code for SmolLM3 is available in transformers `v4.53.0`, so make sure to upgrade your transformers version.
You can use vLLM and SGLang to deploy the model in an API compatible with OpenAI format.
For local inference, you can use `llama.cpp`, `ONNX`, `MLX`, `MLC` and `ExecuTorch`.
you can provide the `/think` and `/no_think` flags through the system prompt
- Under the argument `xml_tools` for standard tool-calling: these tools will be called as JSON blobs within XML tags
